[`nfqws/nfqws2-keenetic`, revision 5d155f33ab00f3a4879c485c1094e8ec1e014586](https://github.com/nfqws/nfqws2-keenetic/blob/5d155f33ab00f3a4879c485c1094e8ec1e014586/etc/nfqws2/nfqws2.conf).
